claims.text: The source replaces the UNet denoiser with a Transformer (DiT-S/B/L/XL, patchified Stable-Diffusion VAE latents, adaLN-Zero best): backbone-vs-objective separation landmark; class-dropout enables classifier-free guidance; sampling-compute cannot compensate model-compute.

Reported numbers: ImageNet-256 XL/2-Guided s=1.5 FID 2.27, sFID 4.60, IS 278.24 at 7M steps vs LDM-4-G 3.60, ADM-G 4.59; ImageNet-512-G FID 3.04; 250-step ancestral sampling; DiT-XL/2 118.6/524.6 GFLOPs vs ADM 1120G.

limitations.text: JAX TPU-v3 throughput figures are hardware-bound; FID sensitive to eval suite; pixel-space DiT not tested.
